acceptance_criteria: src/expr/benchmark.zig implements all 6 profiles from design
Benchmark measures wall-clock latency in microseconds (min/max/mean/p95/p99)
zig build bench exits 0 with structured JSON and text results
Mean latency for typical expressions (profiles 4-5) is reported
task.description: Implement expression evaluation benchmark suite (DSL-13) per design in src/design/expr-benchmark.md. Build benchmarking code in src/expr/benchmark.zig that measures evaluation latency for 6 expression profiles (trivial to complex, 1-10 AST nodes). Integrate with build system via 'zig build bench' target. Run benchmarks and validate against 10 microsecond target for typical expressions.

context.notes: Implement benchmark suite per design. Typical expression (5-10 AST nodes) SHOULD evaluate in <10 microseconds. This is a SHOULD requirement (non-blocking).
